children: Q3 2026 net sales were $87.6M, down approximately 9% from Q2 2026. Duties and tariffs expense was $19.9M, compared with $21.1M in Q2.
Q3 net sales $87.6M, down ~9% vs. Q2
Lower shipments drove the decline, indicating continued demand and volume pressure.
Q3 cost of sales $68.4M, up ~10% vs. Q2
Costs rose despite significantly lower shipment volumes; the inventory provision reversal was $1.0M versus $16.2M in Q2.
Q3 duties and tariffs expense was $19.9M vs. $21.1M
The burden eased from Q2 but remains substantial; the stated combined rate was 45.16%.
Cash was lower than at year-end; the company also reported reduced revolving-facility availability.
Availability declined from Dec. 31, 2025, while $35.5M was drawn versus $18.0M.

This is a quarterly update amid ongoing pressure on Canadian lumber demand, prices, and trade costs. Further improvement would require stronger shipments or pricing, lower trade burdens, or operational gains that support margins and liquidity.
